dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge follows a pronounced concave parabolic spline from the apex down to the posterior insertion point on the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Classified as rounded; the highest morphological point exhibits a smooth pixel curvature without acute termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin contour rises at an angle of approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the fin's maximum pixel base width to its maximum vertical pixel height is approximately 1.45:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant distribution of punctate white scarring and mottled depigmentation across the lateral surface; visible horizontal linear striations on the leading margin; a large diffuse light-colored patch at the posterior base of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The epidermis exhibits a dense, high-contrast salt-and-pepper pigmentation pattern across all visible surfaces.
